notes.title: Opinion on CairnStone Mobile Messages
notes.decisions: The product idea is right: MCP as the transport so humans talk across vendor LLM accounts. Tools exist: me, register, contacts, threads, send, mark_read. Live call needs Messages auth on this connection.
